title: Fantasy Masterpieces #6 Marvel May 1980 Silver Surfer Reprint Worlds Without End
condition_description: Light spine wear and a small crease at the lower left of the front cover; back cover toned. See photos.
description:
Fantasy Masterpieces #6 (May 1980), Marvel Comics - starring the Silver Surfer, "Worlds Without End!" Reprints Silver Surfer #6 (1969) by Stan Lee, John Buscema and Sal Buscema. 75 cent cover price.

Back cover: Lucky Products 100-piece toy soldier set ad.

Condition: light spine wear and a small crease at the lower left of the front cover; back cover toned (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
